premises.text: Current charging methods are inconvenient and require multiple pads for multiple devices
premises.evidence_span: Charging is a terrible experience. Thankfully, last Tuesday, a famous smartphone maker came with the solution, a new charging technology, the charging pad.

premises.text: Existing wireless charging technologies are limited and unsafe
premises.evidence_span: Over the years, a number of other companies have promised wireless power. They've tried microwaves, ultrasound, lasers. None of these technologies are safe at power levels needed to charge a phone.

premises.text: Pi can charge multiple devices simultaneously at different angles
premises.evidence_span: it's charging, too. And we can add a second device. And there we go. It's charging, too. And we can add a third and a fourth.

premises.text: Pi is built around a safe magnetic charging standard
premises.evidence_span: we built Pi around a safe magnetic charging standard.

premises.text: Pi's platform can power devices without needing them to be perfectly aligned
premises.evidence_span: our patented platform can power multiple devices at any angle.

premises.text: Direct-to-consumer sales can sustain viable unit economics
premises.evidence_span: we have over 50% gross margins and anticipate a very high lifetime value per customer.

premises.text: OEM partnerships can extend the platform's reach
premises.evidence_span: we are opening the Pi platform for use by existing consumer electronics OEMs.

value.text: Consumers can charge multiple devices conveniently and safely without wires
value.evidence_span: it's safe, it's affordable, and it's FCC compliant.

notes: Investor names and traction metrics excluded as they do not support premises.
